strings.decision.dp.file_no_confidence.table.pas: tabled a motion of no confidence
strings.decision.dp.file_no_confidence.wait.past: held off on a motion of no confidence
strings.decision.dp.vote_no_confidence.yes.past: voted no confidence in the government
strings.event.politics.no_confidence_tabled: {leader} tables a motion of no confidence in the government.
strings.factor.actor.election_fear.low: a snap election doesn't frighten them
strings.factor.politics.no_confidence_pressure.h: the pressure for a motion of no confidence is high
strings.factor.politics.no_confidence_pressure.l: there is little pressure for a motion of no confidence
strings.procedure.stage.cabinet_reformed: Your new cabinet wins the vote. You are Prime Minister again, weaker than before.
strings.procedure.stage.government_falls: The motion passes. The government falls and stays on as a caretaker until a new one is elected.
strings.procedure.stage.mandate_first: The President hands the first mandate to the largest group: yours. Can you put a new cabinet together?
strings.procedure.stage.mandate_second: The first mandate is returned. The second goes to the second-largest group.
strings.procedure.stage.mandate_third: The second mandate fails. The President gives the third mandate to a group of their choice.
strings.procedure.stage.no_confidence_debate: The National Assembly debates the motion of no confidence. The vote follows in three days.
strings.procedure.stage.no_confidence_failed: The motion of no confidence fails. The government survives.
strings.procedure.stage.no_confidence_vote: The National Assembly votes on the motion of no confidence.
strings.procedure.stage.other_majority: A rival cabinet wins the vote. Another majority governs now.
strings.procedure.stage.snap_election: All three mandates fail. The President appoints a caretaker cabinet and calls a snap election.
strings.var.politics.government_margin.name: Confidence margin
strings.var.politics.no_confidence_pressure.name: No-confidence pressure
